name: impjob
label: Imp to R of having a fulfilling job

questions.text:
I'm going to read you a list of some things that different people value. Some people say these things are very important to them. Other people say they are not so important. Please tell me how important each things is to you personally, using the responses on this card (HAND CARD TO RESPONDENT). How about being financially secure? Is it one of the most important values you hold, very important, somewhat important, not too important, or not at all important? 
G. Having a fulfilling job.

questions.item: G. Having a fulfilling job.

name: sphedslf
label: Spouse's father self-emp when spouse was 16?

questions.text:
A. Now we would like to find out what kind of work your (husband's/wife's) father (OR SUBSTITUTE) did when your (husband/wife) was about 16 years old. What kind of work was your (husband's/wife's) father (OR SUBSTITUTE) doing? That is, what was (his/her) job called?

E. IF ALREADY ANSWERED, CODE WITHOUT ASKING:  Was (he/she) self-employed or did (he/she) work for someone else?
